Callout.Name: Rockfall on a Trail
Callout.Message: Rockfall has blocked a trail, walkers above it.
Callout.Advisory: Walkers on the far side, no injuries.

Script.Line: The trail is blocked and there are people above it.
Four of them, and they cannot come down this way.
It is still moving. Every few minutes another one comes down.

Lines.Approach: The trail is blocked and there are walkers on the wrong side of it.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
